facts.fact: AFP reported that since 2026-09-02 internet bandwidth in Equatorial Guinea was limited and Facebook and TikTok were inaccessible without a VPN, with WhatsApp and Instagram working only in limited form; the source does not say who ordered it and the information minister did not answer AFP; the report is dated 2026-09-16 and gives no end date.

AFP reported that the author of a viral video accusing the vice-president of corruption was arrested by the authorities; the source gives no arrest date, so the report's published date 2026-09-16 is used, and it names neither the person nor the law.
facts.system: Author of the viral video accusing the vice-president
